Declaration.doc:
The declaration as it sits in the file: the `{{#sve_props … #}}` comment
at the top and the `sve_defaults` pair around everything else. Peel it
off, write it back.

Schema.doc:
What a prop may be: its handle (a name Antlers can read), its type, its
label, and the choices a select offers.

facade_doc_extra:
This class is the entry point other code calls; the file shape lives in
`ComponentProps\Declaration` and the rules for one prop in
`ComponentProps\Schema`. Split in WP7d, code moved verbatim.
